description: Extract architectural decisions from an Obsidian note and render them as an inline SVG diagram — black background, white boxes and arrows, chronological top-down flow. Each box shows what was decided, what was rejected, and the meeting where the decision was locked. The SVG is embedded directly in the host note inside an [!info] callout: no external files, no plugins required. Use when asked to "create a decision diagram", "draw decisions as SVG", "make a decision map from this note", "visualise decisions inline", or invokes /decision-svg.
